$comment: GH-719 (queue item 3au) - THE MEASURED CENSUS OF THE HIDDEN WEAR CARD.
Written from the run itself (GH719_PRINT=1), not typed: every field of the
`data-card="traffic"` section of legacy-hub-markup.blade.php, the default the
MARKUP gives it, and every file under `assets` that names its class.
This is a ratchet, not a permission list. A field added to the card, a markup
default changed, or a reader appearing in a file that is not here is red by name,
and so is anything that disappears. The unit is the BLOCK because the item's claim
is about the block: a guard written about matches-per-week alone stays green when
the same defect arrives through matchDuration or trainingRotation.
TWO NUMBERS THIS CORRECTED, both measured: the block holds 18 fields, not 15, and
10 files name them, not 2. `gaip-root-depth` sits in this same card with a markup
default of 100.
THE DEFAULT HAS TWO HOMES, measured: the blade card and `assets/wear-recovery-integration.js`,
which builds the same form in a script with the same values. `declaredWithADefaultIn` carries
both, without line numbers, because a line moves on the next edit and a pinned census goes
stale in silence.
Boundary: a read through a computed class name or a variable holding it is not seen by this
census, and neither is a default assigned in code rather than declared in markup.

GH-776 (queue item 3vt): the four fields of a week of traffic lost their markup defaults, in both homes. The run no longer falls back to this form when a site has no schedule, so a golf course is no longer given a soccer week; measured before that change, ten of thirteen sites carried 5.25 hours with "Soccer (matches)" first. The root depth keeps its default of 100 by the owner's separate decision.
GH-776: and `hub-orchestrator.js` is no longer among the readers of the two weekly counts -- the fallback that read them from this form is gone, and so is the comment that named them.
